reason: Both propose ODS via Y2O3, but B is more specific and testable: it defines a clear intervention (~1 vol% Y2O3), processing route (mechanical alloying + SPS), and a measurable predicted outcome (increase on the order of tens of MPa over 330 MPa), while A is vaguer about processing and predicted gains. B also better grounds the mechanism in retarding recovery and grain-boundary sliding for this BCC alloy, and its falsification experiment is more precisely tied to the baseline.
